gloss: laughing at a memory; chuckling to oneself

definitions.gloss: laughing at a memory; chuckling to oneself
definitions.explanation: suddenly laughing while remembering something funny, often catching others off guard

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{思|おも}い{出|だ}し{笑|わら}い⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I accidentally started chuckling to myself on the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{出|だ}し{笑|わら}い⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまう。
examples.english: I can't help but laugh when I remember what happened yesterday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{思|おも}い{出|だ}し{笑|わら}い⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{気|き}まずかった→気まずい：06536_kimazui⟧。
examples.english: It was awkward when I started laughing at a memory during the meeting.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧ (to remember) + ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧ (laughter)

USAGE:
This often has a slightly embarrassing or socially awkward connotation, as laughing suddenly in public without an apparent reason can seem strange to others.
{思|おも}い{出|だ}し{笑|わら}い in public places like trains can be socially awkward, which is why it's often mentioned with ~⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまう (to do accidentally).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {思|おも}い{出|だ}し{笑|わら}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to laugh at a memory
- {思|おも}い{出|だ}し{笑|わら}い⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまう - to accidentally laugh at a memory
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{思|おも}い{出|だ}し{笑|わら}い - laughing alone at a memory
